subject: Dragonlord
text: The first Dragonlord form is a fake that must be fought with sword attacks, as attack magic fails against both forms.

evidence.quote:
Keep in mind the first Dragonlord you fight is a fake,
but you have to fight it anyway, just use sword attacks. Attack magic
doesn't work on either form of the Dragonlord.

subject: Dragonlord
text: The Dragonlord breathes fire frequently, requiring health to stay above 50.

evidence.quote:
He breathes fire A LOT so make sure your health is always
above 50.

subject: Ball of Light
text: Defeating the Dragonlord restores peace and awards the Ball of Light.

evidence.quote:
When you beat him, it says, "Thou hast found the Ball of Light. Radiance
streams forth as thy hands touch the object and hold it aloft. Across
the land spreads the brilliance until all shadows are banished and peace
is restored."

subject: Tantegel
text: Casting Return transports the player back to Tantegel Castle after Charlock.

evidence.quote:
Then you'll automatically be outside of Charlock, all
healed up and such. Cast return to head back to Tantegel.

subject: King
text: Speaking to the King prompts an offer to rule the land, which the hero declines.

evidence.quote:
Talk to him, and he says,
"The legends have proven true. Thou art indeed of the line of Erdrick.
It is thy right to rule over this land. Will thou take my place?" Then
it says, "[You] thought carefully before answering." "I cannot," said
[You].

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: Princess Gwaelin asks to accompany the hero on his journey as his companion.

evidence.quote:
Then Gwaelin says, "Please, wait. I wish to go with thee on thy
journey. May I travel as thy companion?" You should answer "yes" but if
you answer "no" she'll say "But I must." And you'll have to choose "yes"
so choose "yes" and she'll say, "I'm so happy!"

subject: Erdrick's Tablet
text: Erdrick's Tablet is retrieved inside Erdrick's Cave north of Tantegel.

evidence.quote: Go north to Erdrick's Cave and retrieve Erdrick's Tablet.

subject: Fairy's Flute
text: The Fairy's Flute is retrieved four steps down from the bath in Kol.

evidence.quote:
retrieve the Fairy's Flute, located four steps down from the bath that
cures rheumatism.

subject: Fighter's Ring
text: The Fighter's Ring is retrieved inside Rock Mountain Cave and equipped.

evidence.quote: Traverse the cave, retrieve the Fighter's Ring, and equip it.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: Defeating the Green Dragon in Swamp Cave rescues Princess Gwaelin to be brought to King Lorik.

evidence.quote:
Go back to Swamp Cave, fight the Green Dragon, rescue Princess
Gwaelin, bring her to King Lorik and receive her love.

subject: Silver Harp
text: The Silver Harp is retrieved by opening the northeast door in Garinham to enter Garin's Grave.

evidence.quote:
Open the northeast door in the town, gain access to Garin's Grave.
Then traverse the grave and retrieve the Silver Harp.

subject: Staff of Rain
text: Trading the Silver Harp to the old man northwest of Kol rewards the Staff of Rain.

evidence.quote:
Go to the old man northwest of Kol and trade your Silver Harp for
the Staff of Rain.

subject: Silver Shield
text: A Silver Shield and Flame Sword can be purchased in Cantlin with 23,600 gold at level 15.

evidence.quote:
If you have 23,600 gold saved up and are at least at level 15, time
to go to the town of Cantlin...purchase a Silver Shield and the Flame Sword with the money you've
stock-piled.

subject: Dragonlord
text: If you say "yes" to stand beside the Dragonlord and share the world, he says your journey is over and you're dead.

evidence.quote:
I give thee now a chance to
share this world and to rule half of it if thou will now stand beside
me. What sayest thou? Will the great warrior stand with me?" You should
answer "no" but if you say "yes" he will say, "Really?" and you answer
"yes" again and he says, "Then half of this world is thine, half of the
darkness, and... If thou dies I can bring thee back for another attempt
without loss of thy deeds to date." Then the screen turns red. "Thy
journey is over. Take now a long, long rest. Hahahaha..." Then you're
dead.
